name: Eurotunnel, Border Roleplay
desc:
💣 - New Mafia weapon
🚆 - Easier criminal routes
🐛 - Bug fixes

👮 Defend the border, supervise operations, and rule the border!

Eurotunnel is the link between the UK and France via an underground railway line spanning 31.5 miles. This game aims to unoffically re-create this inside of Roblox
Play as Police, Paramedic, Railway Engineer, Border Supervisor, or Military Police. On the civilian team choose how you live your life, whether that is traveling for holiday, buisness trip, transporting goods, smuggling goods or here to cause some Chaos. 

This game may include flashing imagery.

Police, Paramedic, Military, Border Simulator.

Rules:
- Do not misuse your power
- Use common sense
- No AFK grinding
- Listen to staff

More details on rules can be found in our community comms.
